newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Eng Kong expands in Thailand, Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Eng Kong expands in Thailand, Singapore.

text.p: Shipping container logistics firm Eng Kong Holdings said on Friday it has leased additional land in Thailand and Singapore to expand its storage capacities.
The company said in a statement it had leased 22,400 sq m in Thailand and 20,055 sq m in Singapore.
The additional land will see an increase in the group's Thailand capacity to 4,800 containers, or Twenty foot Equivalent Units (TEUs) and Singapore to 26,000 TEUs.

"The Asian region is enjoying a favourable growth in container throughput. Thailand is no exception," company chairman Eddie Li said in the statement. "We have therefore taken the necessary steps to capture this growth opportunity."
Dennis Chan, Eng Kong's chief financial officer, told Reuters the group expected to fill the new storage capacity in Thailand in the next few months.
The additional land leases were expected to affect the group's earnings only for financial year ending June 30, 1998, Chan said.
